mix: No source audio or music. Twelve separate narration clips at +4 dB.

segments.visualAnchor: Landing hero, sample analysis and pre-build value proposition
segments.text: AI makes software faster to build. BuildCheck helps us decide what is worth building. It is an evidence-first product validation workspace, where founders and agents can challenge an idea before investing in a full product.

segments.visualAnchor: Validate form, idea entry, analysis loading
segments.sourceInspection: Source scene change at 21.2s, loading at 31.7s
segments.text: Let's test an AI CRM for freelancers. Enter the idea in plain English. We are using clearly labeled demo evidence here, with no external lookup.

segments.visualAnchor: Report overview, 53 Build Score, PIVOT, confidence 70
segments.text: The result is PIVOT. Score and confidence are separate. Each dimension explains its contribution, so the recommendation can be inspected.

segments.visualAnchor: Evidence tab with demo labels and provenance
segments.text: Provenance stays visible. Curated examples are not live proof. Generated text never counts as evidence.

segments.visualAnchor: Token ROI tab, directional estimate 31–51 hours
segments.text: The full build is estimated at thirty-one to fifty-one hours. These are directional estimates.
Start smaller: a landing page, paid pilots, and manual delivery. Four to six hours.

segments.visualAnchor: Agent page shows native API detected and seven tools available
segments.text: Here is the WebMCP integration. BuildCheck registers seven native tools on the open page, using document model context. Tools are page-bound, and share the same business services as the human interface.

segments.visualAnchor: Tool catalog then successful validate_idea activity appears
segments.sourceInspection: Source scene changes at 82.2s and 89.4s; invocation completed during recording
segments.text: An agent can validate, challenge, estimate, and propose a smaller MVP. We now invoke the validation tool through WebMCP. It saves the result in this workspace.

segments.visualAnchor: Dashboard shows agent-created project and earlier human-created project
segments.text: The agent-created project is now in the dashboard. The founder can open the report and continue from the same state. There is no separate chat-only copy of the project.

segments.visualAnchor: Agent page, pre-build guard description and activity log
segments.sourceInspection: Source scenes at 108.8s and 113.4s; inspected frame at120s shows successful call
segments.text: The pre-build guard can recommend against a full product. Strict schemas and structured outputs make the tools predictable, while the activity log records outcomes without storing prompts or secrets.

segments.visualAnchor: Settings profile then public data-source registry
segments.sourceInspection: Source scene changes at122.6s and128s; inspected frame136 shows8adapters
segments.text: Here are the provider settings. Eight public adapters require consent, with transparent source failures. This workspace remains demo-only.
BuildCheck. Humans keep the decision. Agents help find the smallest next step worth building.
